card.name: Words just before a drug name
card.fires_on: Small linking or setup words right before a drug or drug class is expected, such as 'taking', 'with', 'or', or 'therapeutic' in interaction sentences. Also fires on a space after 'to' in dose ranges.

modes.label: Linking word before a drug
modes.description: A verb or connector in an interaction or risk sentence, where a drug name comes next.
modes.example: in those<< taking>> corticosteroid or fluoroquin

modes.label: Word before 'agents'
modes.description: The word 'therapeutic' just before 'agents' in an interaction sentence.
modes.example: may blunt the CV effects of several<< therapeutic>> agents used to treat these medical conditions (

modes.label: Dose range gap
modes.description: The space after 'to' in a dose range, just before the upper number.
modes.example: pravastatin sodium tablets 40 mg to<< >>80 mg once daily. (
